recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: institutional doors quietly closing on conversational AI assistants
cyber intrusions settling into background static rather than shock
clear eleven-degree dusk over San Francisco
agents spinning up from a pocket phone
a quieter coding week, repos untouched

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Dodge descending firewall shutters while scooping orphaned data packets in the gaps — each rescue completes one visible log line before context vanishes.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: hold to slow time, release to dash between lanes
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: every rescued packet fills a micro-commit bar that snaps shut at 100%
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: shutters drop faster, gaps narrow, decoy packets appear
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: terminal green glyphs on fog-gray autumn dusk

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap concentric sunset rings as they collapse inward — sync your ship rhythm to the last amber band before night fully arrives.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: rhythm tap on shrinking timing windows
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: a perfect ring streak triggers a brief 'shipped by sunrise' flash
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: rings overlap, off-beat decoys tempt mistimed taps
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: warm gradient halos on indigo clear-sky backdrop

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw a single continuous route from a phone icon to three parallel model nodes without crossing — pick which brain gets the task mid-stroke.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: shortest clean route unlocks a side-by-side plan preview
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: nodes swap positions, moving obstacles block direct paths
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: sketchy whiteboard ink on slate, surgical red highlights

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick luminescent autumn leaves into matching silhouette slots before an offshore wind gust scatters the pile across the screen.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: satisfying nest-in-slot thunk when opacity and shape align
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind gust events, slots shrink, leaves tumble mid-air
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper-cut botanical silhouettes on clear-night navy
